name: rebuild-dossier
description: MCP server that reverse-engineers a locked rebuild spec (CLAUDE.md, .claude config, mutation-tested tests) from an existing app, so coding agents rebuild against a verified contract instead of guessing.
long_description: Before using crawl_site, run `npx playwright install chromium` once — this installs the Chromium binary Playwright needs. It's not bundled with this server, so crawl_site will fail until it's installed.

groq_api_key.title: Groq API Key
groq_api_key.description: Optional. Enables vision-assisted page classification in generate_spec for Next.js targets (also requires REBUILD_DOSSIER_ENABLE_VISION_CLASSIFICATION=1 set in your own environment). Leave blank to skip.
